article.title: Late Canada fightback ends Red Roses' unbeaten streak
article.summary: Canada fight back to beat England 24-21 in Toronto in the WXV Global Series, with Shoshanah Seumanutafa's 77th-minute try ending the Red Roses' unbeaten run, stretching back to the 2022 Rugby World Cup final.
